resolution: The first paint atlas came back at 1024-fit (853x978) which was far too coarse for a 1.84 m vehicle carrying 78 parts and 477 UV islands - the exported guide showed most islands reduced to a few pixels of sliver. Rebuilt the sheet at the 2048 budget without needing another dialog click by driving the supported cart path tools/seat action uv-atlas resize width 1651 height 1899, which resamples the composite through __model_atlas_resize, flips atlasReadyRef, rewrites the package artifacts and rebuilds the UV panel. UV coordinates are normalized so the island layout is untouched and each island simply gains texels: density went from 221 to 441 texels per metre, a 4x area gain per island. Re-exported the pink AI guide at the new 1651x1899 and keyed the whole skin pipeline to those exact dims.
